description: Find independent home-service pros (plumbers, AC/heating, electricians, handymen, roofers, mobile mechanics, cleaners, babysitters and more) listed on TexContractor in a US city. Returns names, service, city and a profile link where the homeowner can see work photos and text the pro directly. Free for homeowners, no lead fees for pros.
